description: Fires when I (the player to move) have a winning cell in column 0: strongest for an immediate win there or stacked column-0 win cells, also when the column-0 win cell is one above the landing cell on my favourable row parity; weaker for any double threat (two immediate wins). Mirror-image column-6 wins do not fire. A diffuse weak band (forced positions, my stones near empty left columns) is not captured.
effect: Raises the probability of playing column 0: zeroing it at high activation cuts column 0 by 0.15-0.42 (e.g. 0.76->0.38, 0.56->0.14), shifting mass to other winning columns; forcing it high adds about +0.2 to column 0.
notes: Best dev F1 0.287 (P 0.33, R 0.25), sim share 0.53 (p4). Col-0 specificity confirmed by mirror pairs (26.4->0.6, 12.1->1.2) and shifted win cell (3.5 vs 0.02). But d=1 col-0 threats are sometimes strongly negative when col 0 is not a good move (engine), parity rule only partly fixes it; ~70% of firings are a diffuse 0.9-3 band (must-block positions, left-side X blocks) with no clean rule. Tried: any col-0 win (0.20), d<=1 (0.22), left windows (0.17), opponent-no-threat filter (0.27), >=3 threats (0.29).
